findings.quote: escaped half naked into a tent
findings.problem: Greek says παρέπεσε γυμνὸς εἴς τινα σκηνήν: simply 'naked' (stripped), no 'half'; the English itself later says 'saw him naked' for ὁρῶντες αὐτὸν γυμνόν.

units.note: Chapter ends mid-sentence by edition split (ἀκμάζειν δὲ νῦν μά|λιστα); not a lacuna.

findings.quote: Moeragenes said that what was chiefly needed was only someone to take the lead.
findings.problem: The sentence continues from ch. 28: ἀκμάζειν δὲ νῦν μάλιστα καὶ προσδεῖσθαι τῶν καταρξομένων. μάλιστα belongs with ἀκμάζειν (already rendered 'now in full strength'); the second clause is just 'and it wanted [only] those who would begin'. 'chiefly needed' misplaces μάλιστα.
findings.proposed_fix: Moeragenes said that it also still needed people to make the start.

units.note: καθ᾽ ὅσον … κατὰ τοσοῦτον correctly rendered 'to the same degree'.

τριταῖον ἀπὸ Κυρήνης ('on the third day from Cyrene') is slightly ambiguous; 'three days earlier' is an acceptable reading, so no fix. ἀντίπαιδα = nearly a boy, 'little son' is loose but not in scope.
